messages:
zoe_fin: spotted an unexpected +$4,800 'burst_charge' on Helix invoice INV-2028-1003. AR shows $72,000 but invoice total = $76,800. link: https://invoices.redwood.example/INV-2028-1003 :confused:
matt_ops: do we have burst records for Helix in that period?
zoe_fin: system matched usage=76800, commit reconciliation=72000, adj line: BURST_RECONCILE:+4800. no sales approval on file. invoice put on hold.
billing-bot: auto-detect: INV-2028-1003 -> commit C-HEL-2028Q1. detected adjustment BURST_RECONCILE amount=4800 origin=postprocess.
claire_csm: Helix was on reserved capacity but also had "allow-burst" enabled. they told us they didn’t want surprise overage charges this quarter.
matt_ops: pulling postprocess logs now. short excerpt:
```
2028-03-25T02:14:01Z POSTPROC INFO invoice=INV-2028-1003 matched_burst=4800 applied_adjustments=[{"code":"BURST_RECONCILE","amount":4800}]
2028-03-25T02:14:02Z POSTPROC INFO invoice=INV-2028-1003 postcheck=combine_with_sla true
2028-03-25T02:14:02Z POSTPROC WARN sla_credit_applied=2000
```
zoe_fin: wait, sla_credit_applied=2000? the invoice shows the full +4800 charge, not netted.
matt_ops: bug: postprocess applied the burst shortfall charge and then a separate SLA credit flow attempted to apply a partial credit but the net didn't persist due to an ordering race. result: customer billed full overage and SLA credit logged only in monitoring, not invoices. opening ticket BG-9705.
billing-bot: ticket BG-9705 created: postprocess ordering race causing missed SLA netting. assigned to matt_ops.
vp_revenue: if we billed an overage by our bug we should reverse the charge and issue corrected invoice. pre-approve refund or credit up to $5k for impacted customers while we fix.
claire_csm: Helix will be upset if billed for something they opted out of. recommend we proactively reverse and include an apology + short explanation.
zoe_fin: finance prefers: 1) reverse +4800, reissue corrected invoice showing SLA credit properly netted, 2) run reconciliation for March batch to find other invoices where sla_credit_applied logged but not reflected. FIN-5940 created to track.
matt_ops: mitigation plan: reorder postprocess so SLA netting happens atomically with burst reconciliation, add idempotency for adjustments. hotfix PR ready; CI passing locally. deploy ETA 4h.
billing-bot: regen-queue: invoices tagged BG-9705 queued for regeneration post-deploy. regen ETA 2028-03-26T06:00:00Z.
zoe_fin: once regen completes finance will reconcile and then either release the AR hold or proceed with corrected collection instructions. please CC finance on Helix communication.
claire_csm: messaging to Helix drafted: short apology, summary of root cause (internal billing race), assurance corrected invoice is on the way, timeline for refund/credit if they already paid. Helix contact replied: "please fix and send corrected invoice ASAP." :pray:
vp_revenue: good outcome plan. ensure memo FIN-5940 documents the credit cap used and audit trail for reversal. escalate if more than 10 affected invoices.
matt_ops: will post CI/deploy logs and regen results here. thanks team.
